dialogues.jp: 「最近、ずっとゲームばっかだったよなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "I've been playing too many games lately......"
dialogues.text: "I've been playing too many games lately......"

dialogues.jp: ぶらぶらと商店街を流しながら呟く。
dialogues.en:
I murmured to myself as I wandered around the shopping
arcade.
dialogues.text:
I murmured to myself as I wandered around the shopping
arcade.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、それもあと少しだ。攻略中のゲームもあ
　と少しでクリアだし」
dialogues.en:
"Well, those days will be over soon. I'm almost finished
with the game I'm playing now."
dialogues.text:
"Well, those days will be over soon. I'm almost finished
with the game I'm playing now."

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、コンビニ弁当も飽きた……」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I'm getting sick of lunch from the convenience
store......"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I'm getting sick of lunch from the convenience
store......"

dialogues.jp:
頭で今日のメニューを考えるが、どれもあまり
食べたい気がしない。
dialogues.en:
I thought about what I wanted to eat, but I didn't feel like
eating anything.
dialogues.text:
I thought about what I wanted to eat, but I didn't feel like
eating anything.

dialogues.jp: ――悲惨な食生活だな。
dialogues.en: ...What a miserable diet I'm having.
dialogues.text: ...What a miserable diet I'm having.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ、眞子じゃん」
dialogues.en: "Hey, isn't that Mako?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, isn't that Mako?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あれっ、朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura?"

dialogues.jp: 流れる人の中に姿を見つけ、互いに立ち止まる。
dialogues.en: We found each other in the crowd and stopped.
dialogues.text: We found each other in the crowd and stopped.

dialogues.jp:
眞子は、両手に同じような紙袋を、ふたつずつ
ぶら提げていた。
dialogues.en: Mako had two similar paper bags in both hands.
dialogues.text: Mako had two similar paper bags in both hands.

dialogues.jp: 「学園の帰りか？　こんなに遅くまで大変だな」
dialogues.en:
"Are you on your way home from school? You've been working
so hard until late, huh?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you on your way home from school? You've been working
so hard until late, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まあね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それにしてもスゴイ荷物だな……何だそれ？」
dialogues.en: "You've got so much to carry...... what are those?"
dialogues.text: "You've got so much to carry...... what are those?"

dialogues.jp: ひょいっ――と中を覗き見る。
dialogues.en: I peeked inside of her bags.
dialogues.text: I peeked inside of her bags.

dialogues.jp:
袋の中には、綺麗に包装された似たような箱が、
ギッシリと詰まっていた。
dialogues.en: The bags were full of neatly wrapped boxes.
dialogues.text: The bags were full of neatly wrapped boxes.

dialogues.jp: 「何だ、それ？」
dialogues.en: "What are these?"
dialogues.text: "What are these?"

dialogues.jp: 見たところチョコみたいな感じだけど。
dialogues.en: They look like boxes of chocolate or something.
dialogues.text: They look like boxes of chocolate or something.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……チョコよ」
dialogues.en: "......They're chocolates."
dialogues.text: "......They're chocolates."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱチョコか…。こんなにいっぱい卒パで
　使うのか？」
dialogues.en:
"That's what I thought. Are you going to use all these at
the graduation party?"
dialogues.text:
"That's what I thought. Are you going to use all these at
the graduation party?"

dialogues.jp: それにしてもスゴイ数だな……。
dialogues.en: There are so many in those bags.
dialogues.text: There are so many in those bags.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Not really......"
dialogues.text: "Not really......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「え？　じゃあ、どうすんだそんなに買って？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Then why did you buy so many?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Then why did you buy so many?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……あたしが返すのよ」
dialogues.en: "......I'm giving them back......"
dialogues.text: "......I'm giving them back......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、明日はホワイトデーか」
dialogues.en: "Oh! Tomorrow's White Day!"
dialogues.text: "Oh! Tomorrow's White Day!"

dialogues.jp: 今日の日付を考えて、ポン、と手を打つ。
dialogues.en: I realized today's date and clapped my hands once.
dialogues.text: I realized today's date and clapped my hands once.

dialogues.jp: 「お前……｛・・・／やっぱ｝男だったのか？」
dialogues.en: "I knew it...... You're really a guy, aren't you?"
dialogues.text: "I knew it...... You're really a guy, aren't you?"

dialogues.jp: ゴスッ――！！
dialogues.en: Bang!!
dialogues.text: Bang!!

dialogues.jp: 「のわっ！」
dialogues.en: "Wow!"
dialogues.text: "Wow!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「
　　　　　　　　　　死・ね
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　」
dialogues.en: " DIE!! "
dialogues.text: " DIE!! "

dialogues.jp: ゾクッ――
dialogues.en: Brrrrr......
dialogues.text: Brrrrr......

dialogues.jp: （さ、寒気が……）
dialogues.en: (I'm shivering......)
dialogues.text: (I'm shivering......)

dialogues.jp: 「すみません……冗談です……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry...... I was just fooling around......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry...... I was just fooling around......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ったく……」
dialogues.en: "Good grief......"
dialogues.text: "Good grief......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「これはバレンタインの時にチョコをくれた｛こ／娘｝
　へのお礼」
dialogues.en:
"I'm giving these to all the girls who gave me chocolate on
Valentine's Day."
dialogues.text:
"I'm giving these to all the girls who gave me chocolate on
Valentine's Day."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「相手って……女の子だよな？」
dialogues.en: "All the girls, huh......?"
dialogues.text: "All the girls, huh......?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うっさいわね」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
女子に人気があるやつだとは知っていたけど。
まさかこれほどとは。
dialogues.en:
I knew she was popular among girls, but I never thought she
was that popular......
dialogues.text:
I knew she was popular among girls, but I never thought she
was that popular......

dialogues.jp: すごいな。
dialogues.en: It's amazing.
dialogues.text: It's amazing.

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても律儀なやつだな。全員にひとつ
　ずつ配るのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, you're so polite. Are you going to give one to each
of them?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, you're so polite. Are you going to give one to each
of them?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「貰ったからには返しておかないとね」
dialogues.en: "I received gifts from them, so I have to return the favor."
dialogues.text: "I received gifts from them, so I have to return the favor."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん……」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんたも、音夢にちゃんと返しなさいよ」
dialogues.en: "You have to give something back to Nemu too!"
dialogues.text: "You have to give something back to Nemu too!"

dialogues.jp:
そういや、手作りのを貰ったっけ。食べれなかっ
たけど……。
dialogues.en:
That's right...... She did give me some homemade chocolates,
although I couldn't really eat them.
dialogues.text:
That's right...... She did give me some homemade chocolates,
although I couldn't really eat them.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあね」
dialogues.en: "See ya!"
dialogues.text: "See ya!"

dialogues.jp: 再び人の流れにのって、眞子が歩いていく。
dialogues.en: Mako started to walk toward the crowd.
dialogues.text: Mako started to walk toward the crowd.

dialogues.jp:
ゆらゆらと揺れる紙袋を見送った後、眞子が買
い物をした店に向かう。
dialogues.en:
After I saw her off, I headed toward the store where Mako
bought her chocolates.
dialogues.text:
After I saw her off, I headed toward the store where Mako
bought her chocolates.

dialogues.jp:
今日の夜――いや、日付が変わったら部屋に行っ
てやろう。
dialogues.en: I'll go to Nemu's room when it's past midnight.
dialogues.text: I'll go to Nemu's room when it's past midnight.

dialogues.jp: 絶対あいつ、起きてるだろうから……。
dialogues.en: I'm sure she'll be awake......
dialogues.text: I'm sure she'll be awake......

dialogues.jp: ◆眞子はもてる◆
dialogues.en: ◆Mako's popular◆
dialogues.text: ◆Mako's popular◆

dialogues.jp:
メシを買いに外に出ると、眞子に出会った。何
やら大量にチョコを持っていた。
dialogues.en:
When I went out to get something to eat, I bumped into Mako.
She had a tremendous amount of chocolates in her bags.
dialogues.text:
When I went out to get something to eat, I bumped into Mako.
She had a tremendous amount of chocolates in her bags.

dialogues.jp:
何事だ……？　そんな疑問に、眞子曰く、自分
のもらったチョコのお返しなんだそうだ。
dialogues.en:
What the heck are those for......? She told me that she's
giving them back to the girls who gave her a gift.
dialogues.text:
What the heck are those for......? She told me that she's
giving them back to the girls who gave her a gift.

dialogues.jp: 眞子の奴、女子に人気あるなあ……。
dialogues.en: Mako's so popular among the girls......
dialogues.text: Mako's so popular among the girls......
